subject: Life Skills
title: Patching Small Wall Holes
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Patching Small Wall Holes.

hook.text: Moving a picture frame leaves nail holes that landlords charge up to fifty dollars each to fix.

buildup.text: Small holes in drywall are purely cosmetic problems. They don't affect structure at all.

discovery.text: Spackle or lightweight filler pressed in with a putty knife covers nail holes in under a minute.

twist.text: Toothpaste works in an emergency for tiny holes, but it cracks and yellows within weeks.

climax.text: Apply spackle, let it dry, sand lightly, and touch up with matching paint. The hole vanishes completely.

punchline.text: Five minutes and spackle. Deposit saved.

quiz.question: What is the proper way to fix a small nail hole in drywall?
options: Fill with toothpaste for a quick permanent fix
Apply spackle, let dry, sand, and paint
Cover with a wall sticker to hide it
